notes.title: Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that the [b]demo is now live on Steam![/b]    

This is an early look at the game. Please note that some technical issues may occur.   

[b]Your feedback is highly appreciated! [/b]Feel free to share your thoughts in the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] or join the discussion on[/p][p][b]Discord[/b]: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/K9kWG8r86S"]https://discord.gg/K9kWG8r86S[/url][/p][p][b]Telegram[/b]: [/p][p][url="https://t.me/AnisimovGames"]https://t.me/AnisimovGames[/url]

Huge thanks to everyone who’s following the project and sharing feedback.

A [b]new trailer[/b] has also been released – make sure to check it out:
[/p][previewyoutube="vGCVc2JpZtY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get Ready – Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
⚡We've been working hard behind the scenes, and now we’re excited to invite you to an [b]upcoming playtest[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256748/889f5c3f32597b106b4f9ecb387eb10d953a4b29.jpg[/img]

🕹️ What to Expect?
[list]
[*] Early hands-on experience with the game
[*] A chance to provide feedback and shape development
[*] Exclusive access before the official release
[/list]

📅 When?
Details coming very soon - make sure to follow and wishlist the game so you don’t miss out!

🔔 How to Join?
Stay tuned! We’ll be sharing all the details shortly.

Be ready - this is your moment to play before anyone else! 🚀
